title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Health and Safety Environment
description: Thrive at work, safeguard your future: Master health & safety, ergonomics, fire safety, systems, and human behavior for a protected and productive environment.
longDescription: Embark on a comprehensive journey through occupational safety and health, ergonomics, system safety, psychology, and terrorism preparedness. From understanding the fundamentals of safety standards and OSHA regulations to exploring the intricacies of ergonomics, system safety management, and psychological factors influencing safety behavior, this course offers a multidimensional approach to creating and maintaining a safe working environment.
courseDetails: Explore the Definition of ‘‘Ergonomics’’ and its importance in health science. Learn how to Apply Ergonomics Evaluate Operator-Machine Systems Understand the classification of Body Movement, Postures, and Positions Explore Cumulative Trauma Disorders or CTD. Understand Machine Variables and Environmental Variables affecting the health and safety of employees. Explore Workplace Layout and Design Appreciate FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION techniques Explore the Categories of Fires and Extinguishers Definition of system safety. Understand Management of System Safety. Explore the Elements of a System-Safety Program Plan. Appreciate Tools and Techniques of System Safety. Appreciate Job Safety Analysis. Understand the Elements of a System-Safety Program Plan. Explore Tools and Techniques. Learn Job Safety Analysis. Explore MANAGING THE SAFETY FUNCTION Evaluation of the System Explore Motivation, Maslow’s Needs-Hierarchy Theory, McClelland's Need-Achievement Theory. Herzberg's Motivation Hygiene Theory, Pavlov theory and Skinner theory of motivation. Appreciate The Rational Employee: Applying Motivation Theories. Understand Organisational Environment and the Safety Culture. Learn Incentives and Inherent Reinforcement. Evaluate Employee Empowerment and Job Enrichment. Understand Principles and Strategies of Behavioral Safety. Explore Common Problems with Safety Efforts. Learn Process Focusing on Improving Safety Behavior. Behaviour Sampling for Proactive Measures. Implementing Behavioral Approaches Understand Safety Coaching Explore Workplace violence Explore terrorism’s recent history. Understand Safety measures to tackle terrorism. Appreciate Electrical Safety and how to Electric shock and burns. Treatment of electric shock and burns. Explore causes of electrical fires and explosions. Understand Preventive measures. By studying Health and Safety Environment, individuals can understand the factors contributing to workplace safety and environmental sustainability, including risk assessment, hazard management, emergency preparedness, and compliance with regulatory standards. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Occupational Safety and Health: Ergonomics, Fire Prevention, and Protection Management: System Safety and Managing the Safety Function: Psychology And Safety: The Human Element in Loss Prevention: Terrorism Preparedness and Electrical Safety:
